resources.string: A random viewer who has chatted this stream: {random.chatter}
A random chatter this stream, never the viewer who triggered it: {random.chatter.notMe}
A random chatter this stream with an @ in front, so they get a mention: {random.chatter.mention}
A random quote of the channel with its number, author and date: {random.quote}
One quote of the channel by its number, for example #12 "text": {quote:12}
The words of a quote by its number: {quote.text:12}
Who said a quote, by its number: {quote.author:12}
The game that was on when a quote was said, by its number: {quote.game:12}
The day a quote was said, in the channel's time zone: {quote.date:12}
How many quotes the channel has: {quote.count}
The newest quote of the channel with its number: {quote.latest}
Keeps a value under a name for the rest of this reply and prints nothing. Read it with {name} or {var.name}: {set:name=value}
Reads a value that {set:name=value} kept earlier in this reply: {var.name}
Prints the reply of another command of the channel, filled in for the same viewer: {include.cmd:name}
Prints the reply of a built-in command that only reads information any viewer may see, for example uptime: {include.builtin:uptime}
Prints one entry of a pick list by its position, counted from 1: {include.list:name|position}
